title: mail config: stringly-typed log.format and verify_http_signatures
description:
Why this issue exists: In crates/mail/src/config.rs, LogConfig.format is a String (values 'json' or 'text') and ActivityPubConfig.verify_http_signatures is also a String (values 'true' or 'false'). Both should be typed enums or bool respectively, catching invalid config values at deserialization time instead of at runtime.

What needs to be done: Replace LogConfig.format with an enum (e.g. LogFormat { Json, Text }) with serde rename_all. Replace verify_http_signatures String with bool. Update all callsites.
